name: Objects
meaning: Stable physical/place/logical identity separated from snapshot descriptions and source records

name: SourceDocuments
meaning: Source document identity is carried by record locators; document metadata and ownership need a dedicated contract

name: SourceRevisions
meaning: Source revision identifiers occur in records and snapshots; addressable revision metadata and fingerprints remain undefined

name: SourceObjects
meaning: Original source row locators distinguish occurrence records from definitions and metadata

name: Correspondences
meaning: Confirmed/candidate/rejected assertions relate source records to semantic identities with evidence

name: Projects
meaning: Project-kind objects and locations exist; a dedicated project overview and project-specific fields remain undefined

name: Sites
meaning: Site-kind objects exist; site boundaries and geographical context need refinement

name: Buildings
meaning: Building-kind objects exist; readable building summaries and source-to-building mapping need refinement

name: Storeys
meaning: Storey-kind objects exist; elevations and multi-storey containment conventions remain undefined

name: Spaces
meaning: Space-kind objects and finish associations exist; space boundaries and occupancy need refinement

name: Zones
meaning: Zone-kind objects exist; overlapping analytical zones need purpose and membership rules

name: SpatialMemberships
meaning: Generic containment/location/membership assertions exist; spatial scope and overlap semantics remain provisional

name: CoordinateFrames
meaning: Declared dimensionality and parent transforms place coordinates in explicit frames

name: Placements
meaning: Available locations carry frame-referenced points; full occurrence orientation and reusable prototype placement remain incomplete

name: GeometryRepresentations
meaning: Addressable geometry is separated by object/purpose/frame with optional search envelopes

name: Walls
meaning: Wall-kind component occurrences exist; typed wall construction and opening relationships need refinement

name: Floors

name: Ceilings

name: Roofs

name: Doors
meaning: Door schedules expose fire rating and clear width; complete door/hardware specifications remain incomplete

name: Windows
meaning: Window-kind component occurrences exist; glazing and window performance specifications remain undefined

name: Openings
meaning: Opening-kind objects exist; void geometry and host/portal interpretation need refinement

name: Facades

name: Stairs

name: Railings

name: StructuralMembers
meaning: Structural-member occurrences exist; section/material/orientation and structural behavior fields need refinement

name: Foundations

name: Connections
meaning: Generic edges can associate structural objects; connection assemblies and structural joint semantics need a dedicated contract

name: Terrain

name: PavedAreas
meaning: Paved-area occurrences exist; pavement assemblies and surface grading remain undefined

name: DrainageAssets
meaning: Drainage-specific object types and catchment/capacity/service relationships require domain design

name: FinishSurfaces

name: FinishLayers
meaning: Material parts and measurement scopes exist; ordered finish layers and their specifications remain undefined

name: Fixtures
meaning: Fixture-kind occurrences exist; fixture-specific specifications and service requirements remain undefined

name: Furniture
meaning: Furniture-kind occurrences exist; furniture schedules and procurement specifications remain undefined

name: PlantingAreas
meaning: Planting-area occurrences exist; soil/species/coverage and planting schedules remain undefined

name: LandscapeAssets
meaning: Landscape-asset occurrences exist; species/maturity and maintenance specifications remain undefined

name: Systems
meaning: System-kind objects and membership/serves edges exist; system-specific operating/design data need refinement

name: Equipment
meaning: Equipment occurrences and maintainable-asset projections exist; engineering schedules remain incomplete

name: Ports

name: Connections
meaning: Accepted/candidate connectivity edges carry medium and evidence; electrical/fluid engineering constraints remain incomplete

name: Circuits
meaning: Circuit-kind objects exist; phases/loads/protection and electrical calculation contracts remain undefined

name: ServiceAreas
meaning: Generic serves edges and spatial objects exist; service-zone definitions and coverage rules remain incomplete

meaning: Material identities exist; composition/product/specification fields need a dedicated contract

name: Assemblies

name: QuantityObservations
meaning: Measurements retain scope/kind/basis/availability and selection provenance independently of geometry proxies

name: EstimateItems

name: Deliveries

name: ImpactResults

name: Requirements
meaning: Versioned requirement references exist; individual rule definitions and applicability need a dedicated contract

name: PropertyObservations

name: MappingDecisions
